{"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。","id":"gh:1348805637","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-novel-solo","slug":"Tkingxiao/dsh-novel-solo","topics":["deepseek","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-plugin","novel-writing"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 的「单核写作」插件：面向量化小模型做了充分的工具瘦身与输出加固，适合在本机用本地模型跑长篇小说流水线。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-novel-solo"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"A **single-author novel-writing plugin** for DeepSeek Harness: a **subagent concurrency setting** pl"},{"id":"p3s2","text":"us a **complete novel-creation preset** (persona). It is tuned for quantized small models — the tool"},{"id":"p3s3","text":" catalog is slimmed and output behavior hardened — so you can run a full-length novel pipeline local"},{"id":"p3s4","text":"talog is slimmed and output behavior hardened — so you can run a full-length novel pipeline locally."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **GUI setting**: a "Subagent count (1-12)" card on the plugin page (0.1.7: left rail → Plugins; 0."},{"id":"p5s2","text":"1.6: Settings → Plugins), with built-in zh/en i18n.
- **Full creation preset**: ships the `novel-sol"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"o` preset with a self-driven persona that follows a fixed pipeline — 叙事方法 (narrative method) → 核心世界观"},{"id":"p5s4","text":" (core worldview) → 名词索引 (noun index) → 大纲 (outline) → 章节目录 (chapter list) → 人物档案 (character files) "},{"id":"p5s5","text":"→ chapter-by-chapter writing → per-chapter review → final whole-book review & assembly.
- **Quantize"},{"id":"p5s6","text":"d-safe protocol**: plain CJK + common punctuation only, no JSON, no escapes, avoids fragile tokens; "},{"id":"p5s7","text":"minimal tool calls, one at a time.
- **Review loop**: every chapter is reviewed (green/yellow/red) a"},{"id":"p5s8","text":"cross 7 dimensions (setting / character / catalog / narrative / text rules / AI-cliché / plot logic)"},{"id":"p5s9","text":"; each report is written to a markdown file; when all chapters pass, a whole-book review runs and th"},{"id":"p5s10","text":"e book is assembled.
- **No AI clichés**: judges AI-flavor across six dimensions (sentence templates"},{"id":"p5s11","text":" / stock vocabulary / emotion telling / structural sameness / diluted information / character distor"},{"id":"p5s12","text":"tion), distinguishing narrator-level repetition from character-level consistency; shared by writing "},{"id":"p5s13","text":"and review.
- **Slimmed catalog**: hard-disables whole tool rows (shell / jobs / skills / goals / we"},{"id":"p5s14","text":"b) inside the preset to shrink the tool schema.
- **Versioned writing**: each chapter is `第N章-章节名字-v"},{"id":"p5s15","text":"X.md`; full-chapter rewrites first copy to v(X+1) and never overwrite older drafts."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Then open the plugin page — **Plugins** in the left rail on 0.1.7, **Settings → Plugins** on 0.1.6 —"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" and the dsh-novel-solo "Subagent count" card appears."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"On hosts older than 0.1.7 the plugin additionally **deploys the preset idempotently** from `template"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"/` to `<dshHome>/.agent-presets/novel-solo/`, because that was the only preset contract there (an ex"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"isting target is skipped — your edited preset is never overwritten). On 0.1.7 nothing is deployed: t"},{"id":"p9s4","text":"he preset arrives as a declarative row in the profile patch."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Host compatibility"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"The plugin supports **DSH `0.1.6-alpha.1` / `0.1.6-alpha.2` and, from `0.1.7-alpha.1` on, every late"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"r host release** and picks its route per host. Both halves probe the host's own version through `ctx"},{"id":"p11s3","text":".profileContext.installAnchor` — the YAML `disabled:` gate in `cordis.patch.yml` and the same check "},{"id":"p11s4","text":"in `lib/index.js` — and fall back to the 0.1.6 route whenever the version cannot be read. Everything"},{"id":"p11s5","text":" from 0.1.7 on takes the same route, 0.2.0 included."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| | 0.1.6 | 0.1.7 and later |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Preset delivery | deploy `template/` into `<dshHome>/.agent-presets/novel-solo/` | declarative `@d"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"eepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` row in the patch |
| Where `N` is saved | `dsh-novel-solo` settings nam"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"espace the plugin registers | the plugin's own `Config` (`count` is `volatile`), projected into the "},{"id":"p13s4","text":"profile patch |
| Card slot | `settings.plugin.item` via `settingsScope` | `plugins.item` via `confi"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"atch |
| Card slot | `settings.plugin.item` via `settingsScope` | `plugins.item` via `configForms` |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"Both routes are exercised against a real host; the 0.1.7 one on `0.1.7-rc.1` (card renders on the Pl"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"ugins page, saves land in `cordis.patch.yml`, preset shows up in the picker). The 0.1.6 route is cov"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"ered by the same version gate offline, since no 0.1.6 host binary is installed next to the 0.1.7 one"},{"id":"p14s4","text":". The hosts actually installed here now are `0.2.0-rc.1`, `0.2.1-alpha.3` and `0.2.1-rc.2`, and both"},{"id":"p14s5","text":" plugins were installed and booted side by side on each: the node half runs (the `.dsh-novel-solo-da"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"ta` mirror is still written), `--dump-config` shows both declaration rows and the `novel-solo` roste"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"r id, and nothing gets force-disabled. The card itself was not re-clicked in a 0.2.1 browser, but ev"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"ery seam it rides on was checked against the host source at `0.2.1-rc.2` — the `plugins.item` slot, "},{"id":"p14s9","text":"`configForms.get` / `whileServed`, `settings.configure` / `update`, the client manifest's `id`/`url`"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"/`rev`, and `bind` / `register` on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale` — all identical to `0.1.7-rc.1`;"},{"id":"p14s11","text":" the same seam list was re-read at `0.2.1-rc.3` and none of it moved (the plugin-manager page only g"},{"id":"p14s12","text":"ained an additive `openList()` reflection method for the new entry-customization plugin). `0.1.7-rc."},{"id":"p14s13","text":"n additive `openList()` reflection method for the new entry-customization plugin). `0.1.7-rc. [长行截断]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How the subagent count takes effect"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"DSH's `agent/request` waterfall only lets a plugin rewrite LLM routing/config — it cannot inject or "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"rewrite `system`/`messages` — so "GUI → model prompt" dynamic injection cannot go through the reques"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"t waterfall. This plugin wires the value through files instead:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"1. The card saves `N` into the host's settings store (see the table above). That is the source of tr"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"uth.
2. On load, the node half mirrors it to `<dshHome>/.dsh-novel-solo-data/agent-count.json`.
3. T"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"he persona row resolves `!!js` while the preset loads: it reads `template/persona.md` and replaces t"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"hat file's `并发上限 N=<number>` anchor with the mirrored number. The persona then decides: `N=1` the ma"},{"id":"p18s5","text":"in agent does everything itself; `N>1` writing/review tasks are delegated to subagents while the mai"},{"id":"p18s6","text":"n agent only dispatches and silently waits."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"> Note: the mirror and the persona are both resolved while the host loads its plugins, so **a GUI ch"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"ange reaches the prompt only after a host restart**. Volatile settings give the node side no change "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"callback, so there is nothing to push the new value out live."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"## Preset at a glance"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"The persona body lives in `template/persona.md`; `template/agent.cordis.yml` (mirrored into `cordis."},{"id":"p21s2","text":"patch.yml`) carries the tool rows around it. Content:"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| Section | Content |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| Division of labor | concurrency anchor `N=1` (default), with N=1 / N>1 execution paths |
| Quantiz"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ed-safe rules | top-priority constraints on output and tool calls |
